description: Source code for Wi-Fi access point security management, including security mode validation, configuration, and shared security configuration checks.

methods.name: wld_ap_sec_doSync
methods.description: Synchronizes security settings of an access point and notifies auto-commit manager.

methods.name: s_getFinalModesAvailable
methods.description: Determines the final available security modes based on supported and available masks.

methods.name: s_getFinalModeEnabled
methods.description: Determines the final enabled security mode based on available modes and requested mode.

methods.name: wld_ap_sec_checkSecConfigParams
methods.description: Validates security configuration parameters for an access point.

methods.name: _wld_ap_validateSecurity_ovf
methods.description: Validates overall security configuration for an access point object.

methods.name: s_setWEPKey_pwf
methods.description: Sets WEP key for an access point.

methods.name: s_setModesAvailable_pwf
methods.description: Sets available security modes for an access point.

methods.name: s_setModeEnabled_pwf
methods.description: Enables a specific security mode for an access point.

methods.name: s_setKeyPassPhrase_pwf
methods.description: Sets KeyPassPhrase for an access point.

methods.name: s_setSaePassphrase_pwf
methods.description: Sets SAE passphrase for an access point.
